author: SepsisShock
description: Header banners, avatar styling (In Line, Backdrop or Pop Out, with shapes including heart and star, rounded corners, crop focus, fades and fit), reasoning block styling (button, box, background patterns, typewriter status text), text styling, foreground images, Edit Placement (drag pop-out avatars and foreground images on screen, with Snap to Grid and Undo), Layout (move and resize the chat panel and send bar, and put SillyTavern's menu bar on any edge of the screen, with separate desktop and phone layouts and a Phone Preview), UI display settings (shape, color, opacity and border for the chat panel, messages and send box, hidden names and pictures, scrollbar colors and custom CSS, custom cursor for normal, pointer, text and click), themes (which also remember which regex folders are on), a Regexes page (SillyTavern's Global, Preset and Character regexes in folders you can switch on and off, reorder, import and export), and an optional Visual Novel Mode with choices, effects, CG scenes, maps and opening videos. Open the menu from the Extensions page, the wand menu (optional) or /ntr.
